title: The capture toast and menu bar menu in the mocks match what shipped
goal: The app's capture toast now carries an Edit row with its shortcut, and hover shows Copy and Dismiss, but the mock author rules still describe the toast as a thumbnail plus Copied to clipboard with no controls at all. The mock is the proposal the next capture task will build from, so it should show the shipped shape. Bring the rules and the capture mock page in line with the app, in that direction only.
notes: Evidence: docs/design/mocks/shared/AGENTS.md lines 587 to 635 (toast described as transient with no dismissal chrome, menu lists Stop Recording) against commits 17b11b9 (toast Edit row, next-capture-toast-edit) and 50b72c3 (capture command names). Rule scrub queued by the 2026-09-02 digest design review.
acceptance: The GLOBAL surfaces section of docs/design/mocks/shared/AGENTS.md describes the toast as shipped: thumbnail, message, a full-width Edit row with Shift Command 6 at its end, Copy and Dismiss on hover, no key shown on a Touch Bar Mac.
The menu bar menu rows in that section match the app's Capture menu names and order (Capture Region, Capture Full Screen, Record Screen / Video, Edit Last Capture, Show History).
The capture mock page that renders .ctoast shows the Edit row and passes the page checklist.
No app code changes; nothing is back-ported from the mock into the app.

Section 3 of docs/design/mocks/shared/UX-PATTERNS.md names the canvas notice pill (the mode hint and the Copied pill share it) as its own transient surface, with its slot rule: bottom centre above the tool bar, one at a time, reserved while the Measure tool is in hand.

log.note: folded in: UX-PATTERNS section 3 gains the canvas notice pill (digest design review 2026-09-02)

Adversarial review before editing: the shipped toast (ToastController, next-capture-toast-edit) is picture, green check + message, a full-width Edit row with ⇧⌘6 trailing; hover shows Dismiss, and Copy only on a recording (Copy Video / Copy GIF). Copy is not on a screenshot toast, so the rule says so instead of promising it. The toast is system glass in the app but fixed-dark in the mock; left the tint alone (shape is the deliverable) and made the CSS comment stop claiming tint parity.

Menu: the mock menus said Stop Recording (disabled) and Preferences…; the app says Record Screen / Video… (Stop Recording only while recording), has Edit Last Capture ⇧⌘6 after the first separator, and Experiments…, no Preferences. Fixed the rule text, entry.js (the injected menu every walkthrough uses), app-shell.html and walk.html, and the video-entry-wt step copy that described the grayed row.

Toast component: .cedit Edit row, .cact hover pill (Dismiss; .copy shown on .ctoast.rec), .nokey modifier for the Touch Bar case; toast.js Dismiss hides the specimen (wt-off) and removes clones, clones strip wt-off. Pages: capture-wt, walk, app-shell (both specimens). Docs: AGENTS.md GLOBAL surfaces, PRODUCT-MODEL §4e.3, UX-PATTERNS §3 Canvas notice bullet with the slot rule.

Verified: node shared/build-ds.mjs rebuilt dist; check-reserved, check-selection, check-a11y-names, check-shortcuts, check-elevation, check-states, audit-keyboard all pass (menu rows 1419/1419 keyboard reachable). Chrome at 1280x900: capture-wt toast renders the Edit row with ⇧⌘6 at the end, no horizontal overflow; app-shell shows Copy on the recording card only and the hover pill appears on hover/focus.

Mock rules and pages now show the shipped capture toast (Edit row with Shift Command 6, Dismiss on hover, Copy on a recording, no key on a Touch Bar Mac) and the app's menu bar menu names and order (Record Screen / Video, Edit Last Capture, Experiments). AGENTS.md GLOBAL surfaces, PRODUCT-MODEL 4e.3, UX-PATTERNS section 3 Canvas notice with its slot rule, toast component, entry.js menu, capture-wt / walk / app-shell pages. No app code. Verified: build-ds, all mock check scripts and audit-keyboard pass, Chrome render at 1280x900, Scripts/test.sh green. Commit 86773ae.
